request: I'd like to fly down to Orlando two days early, on March 12th, and take two days of annual leave before the conference; I'll pay my own hotel for those nights. If the state can't do that at no extra cost, just book me on the 14th.

trip.agency: Mississippi Library Commission, Picayune regional office
trip.purpose: State library association conference in Orlando, opening session at 8:00 on March 15

must_keep.quote: Business travel and vacation/personal leave may be combined when all of the following conditions are met: • The primary purpose of the trip is official state business. • The employee uses his approved leave for the personal part of the trip. • The state agency incurs no expenses beyond what it would have incurred had there been no personal travel involved in the trip. (If the employee would normally be expected to arrive the day before or remain in the area of official business overnight and return the following morning, and does so, expenses for either/both night(s) and the appr opriate meals will be allowed.); and,
must_keep.why: business and personal leave combined only when the primary purpose is state business, leave is approved and the agency incurs no extra expense

must_keep.quote: Travelers shall request air, train, bus, hotel, and vehicle rental reservations as far in advance as possible and shall utilize the lowest logical rate available.
must_keep.why: the default: the lowest logical rate available

design_notes: Lines 642-651: the primary purpose is the conference, the leave is approved, the traveller pays the leave nights, and the March 12 fare ($236) is no more than the March 14 lowest ($236): the agency incurs no extra expense, so book March 12 as asked. The March 14 fare at the same price ignores a permitted request.
